annotations.title: Fix a listing for a Moda group

description:
Use when someone's listing has words a Moda group's automatic filter declines, or they ask Moda to fix their post. This is the Post Checker's Fix my post, run on Moda's servers.
text: the listing as written. group: optional slug of the group it is for; leave it out to fix it for every group at once.
Returns JSON: the rewritten listing to copy, each change made (a brand name bent so the filter passes, a word swapped or removed, and why), and any words that stop the post entirely, such as replica terms, where no rewrite is offered.

group.description: Optional group slug: tmc (The Moda Club (TMC)), modagoldplus (Moda Gold+), watchtrading (Moda Watch Club), 558871041349029 (Moda Watch Club: 10K & Under), watchbuying (Moda Watch: WTB/ISO), modaforum (Moda Watch Forum), 607987992210015 (Moda Clubs® - News & Announcements), wholesalecarclub (Wholesale Car Club), carwanna (Wholesale Car Club: Forum), modagold (Moda Gold Club), 440285754441122 (Moda Collective), 754566649197672 (Moda Lifestyle Club), 1588523368275459 (Moda Fitness Club), modahype (Moda Hype Club), modamisc (Moda Misc Club).
